description: This file defines the VersionNegotiator class in the Drupal JSON:API module, responsible for managing entity revision version negotiation, including adding negotiators and retrieving specific revisions based on version identifiers.

classes.name: VersionNegotiator
classes.description: Manages version negotiation for entity revisions in Drupal JSON:API, allowing addition of negotiators and retrieval of specific revisions based on version identifiers.

methods.name: addVersionNegotiator
methods.description: Adds a version negotiator to the internal list, asserting it belongs to the Drupal namespace.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entity revision based on a version identifier, handling errors if revision not found or identifier invalid.

methods.name: throwNotFoundHttpException
methods.description: Throws a 404 HTTP exception if the requested revision does not exist, with cacheability metadata.

methods.name: throwBadRequestHttpException
methods.description: Throws a 400 HTTP exception if the version identifier is invalid, with cacheability metadata.
